rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose, gender-neutral way to say that someone weds A.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 git3 fan1 laa3

rows.note: A woman uses this when she weds someone, rather than the gender-neutral construction.

example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: A man uses this when he takes a wife, rather than the gender-neutral construction.

example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ceoi2 zo2 go3 lou5 po4

rows.note: Use this when a priest, celebrant, or other official performs the marriage ceremony for the couple.

example.english: The pastor will wed the couple tomorrow.
example.traditional: 牧師聽日會幫佢哋證婚。
example.jyutping: muk6 si1 ting1 jat6 wui5 bong1 keoi5 dei6 zing3 fan1
